extraction.extracted_text:
Axis Large Cap Fund — Direct Plan (Growth) delivered an impressive 15% return over the last 1 year.

The fund manages ₹30,912 crore in assets under management, with a link to AUM by geography at [AMC website]/aum.

Product label and benchmark risk-o-meter shown alongside. Different plans have a different expense structure.
Past performance may or may not be sustained in future.
Mutual Fund investments are subject to market risks, read all scheme related documents carefully.

features.evidence: delivered an impressive 15% return over the last 1 year
manages ₹30,912 crore in assets under management
Axis Large Cap Fund — Direct Plan (Growth)

results.title: No assured or guaranteed returns
results.description: The creative must not state, imply, or suggest assured, guaranteed, protected, risk-free, or fixed returns for any mutual fund scheme.
results.source_clause: SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulations 1996, Sixth Schedule (Advertisement Code) clause (b); MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, Chapter 14
results.explanation: The creative only states a past return figure with the required disclaimers and does not promise or imply any guaranteed, fixed, or risk-free future return.

results.title: No false, misleading, or deceptive statements
results.description: The creative must not contain statements that are false, misleading, biased, or deceptive, based on assumptions or projections, and must not mislead directly, by implication, or by omission.
results.source_clause: Sixth Schedule (Advertisement Code) clauses (a), (b), (c)
results.offending_text: delivered an impressive 15% return over the last 1 year
results.explanation: Calling the return 'impressive' is a subjective, promotional judgment rather than a neutral fact, which can bias investors' perception of past performance.
results.suggested_rewrite: Remove the word 'impressive' and simply state the factual figure, e.g., 'delivered a 15% return over the last 1 year.'

results.title: No exaggerated or unwarranted slogans
results.description: The creative must not carry any slogan that is exaggerated or unwarranted, or that is inconsistent with or unrelated to the nature, risk, and return profile of the product, including unsubstantiated superlatives.
results.source_clause: Sixth Schedule (Advertisement Code) clause (d)
results.offending_text: delivered an impressive 15% return over the last 1 year
results.explanation: Calling the return 'impressive' is a subjective, unsubstantiated superlative that isn't backed by any comparison or context and could mislead investors about the fund's true risk-return profile.
results.suggested_rewrite: Remove the word 'impressive' and simply state the factual figure, e.g., 'delivered a 15% return over the last 1 year', letting the performance data speak for itself.

results.title: No testimonials or rankings
results.description: The creative must not contain any testimonials or any ranking based on any criteria.
results.source_clause: Sixth Schedule (Advertisement Code) clause (b)

results.title: No discrediting or unfair comparisons
results.description: The creative must not directly or indirectly discredit other advertisements or make unfair comparisons.
results.source_clause: Sixth Schedule (Advertisement Code) clause (h)
results.explanation: The creative only presents the fund's own performance and facts without mentioning, discrediting, or comparing itself to other advertisements or competing funds.

results.title: Consistent with SID/SAI/KIM
results.description: The creative must contain information that is timely and consistent with the disclosures made in the Scheme Information Document, Statement of Additional Information, and Key Information Memorandum; it must not claim features beyond those disclosures.
results.source_clause: Sixth Schedule (Advertisement Code) clause (g)
results.explanation: Assisted rule — requires a human check.

results.title: No exploiting investor inexperience; avoid excessive jargon
results.description: The advertisement must not be framed to exploit the lack of experience or knowledge of investors. Extensive use of technical or legal terminology, complex language, or excessive detail that may detract investors must be avoided.
results.source_clause: Sixth Schedule (Advertisement Code) clause (f)
results.explanation: The creative uses plain, standard mutual fund terms (returns, AUM, risk-o-meter, expense structure) without dense jargon or misleading complexity that would confuse an inexperienced investor.

results.title: No forecasts or projections; commentary limits
results.description: The advertisement must not present forecasts, assumed returns, or numerical forecasts of GDP or any stock metric. General market and economic commentary is permitted; stock-specific commentary is not; sector commentary is permitted only if it contains no numerical forecasts.
results.source_clause: Sixth Schedule (Advertisement Code) clause (b); internal Dos & Don'ts guidance

results.title: No celebrity in the advertisement
results.description: No celebrity shall form part of the advertisement — whether by depiction, endorsement, or by name or reference (e.g. an article drawing an analogy to a named celebrity's discipline or routine). When a prominent person is detected or a well-known name is referenced, they must be reviewed against the celebrity definition below — a match on any single criterion makes the person a celebrity. Principle: once a celebrity, always a celebrity.
results.source_clause: Sixth Schedule (Advertisement Code) clause (e); internal celebrity checklist (7-part definition)

results.title: No caricatures, avatars, or memes of cine personalities
results.description: The creative must not use caricatures, avatars, or memes of popular cine actors, movie posters, movie or series scenes, or 'filmi' dialogues in promotional material, especially on social media.
results.source_clause: Internal celebrity checklist item 8; Sixth Schedule (Advertisement Code) clause (e)

results.title: Standard 14-word market-risk warning (verbatim)
results.description: The creative must carry the standard warning in legible font, verbatim, with no addition or deletion of words.
results.source_clause: Sixth Schedule (Advertisement Code) clause (i)

results.title: Vernacular (Hindi) standard warning
results.description: When the creative is in a vernacular language, it must carry the standard warning in that language. A Hindi creative must carry the Hindi standard warning verbatim.
results.source_clause: Sixth Schedule (Advertisement Code) clause (ia)

results.title: Sponsor liability disclaimer
results.description: Scheme creatives must carry the sponsor liability disclaimer stating the sponsor is not liable or responsible for any loss or shortfall resulting from the operation of the scheme.
results.source_clause: Internal compliance checklist — Disclaimer Repository (Sponsor/Statutory disclaimer)
results.explanation: A disclaimer this creative must carry is missing (or its wording differs too much from the mandated text — closest match 44%).
results.suggested_rewrite: Add this exact text: “The Sponsor - [Sponsor Bank], is not liable or responsible for any loss or shortfall resulting from the operation of the scheme.”

results.title: Product suitability disclaimer
results.description: Scheme creatives must carry the product suitability statement advising investors to consult their financial advisers if in doubt about whether the product is suitable for them.
results.source_clause: MF Master Circular 2026-03-20 (product labelling / product suitability); internal checklist (KV requirements)
results.explanation: A disclaimer this creative must carry is missing (or its wording differs too much from the mandated text — closest match 44%).
results.suggested_rewrite: Add this exact text: “Investors should consult their financial advisers if in doubt about whether the product is suitable for them.”

results.title: Product labelling and risk-o-meter
results.description: Scheme creatives must include the product label with the scheme and benchmark risk-o-meter (and the Potential Risk Class matrix for debt schemes), displayed legibly.
results.source_clause: MF Master Circular 2026-03-20 (product labelling); internal checklist (KV requirements)
results.explanation: Assisted rule — requires a human check.

results.title: Past-performance disclaimer when performance shown
results.description: When performance of any scheme, category, index, or benchmark is shown, the creative must carry the standard performance disclaimer that past performance may or may not be sustained in future.
results.source_clause: MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, Chapter 14; internal Performance checklist item 11

results.title: Stock disclaimer when stocks are named
results.description: When individual stocks are named, the creative must carry the stock disclaimer clarifying that the stocks are used to explain the concept, are for illustration only, are not investment advice, and may or may not be part of the portfolio.
results.source_clause: Internal compliance checklist — Disclaimer Repository (Stock disclaimer)

results.title: Sector disclaimer when sectors are named
results.description: When sectors are named, the creative must carry the sector disclaimer clarifying that the sectors are for general assessment only, not a complete disclosure, not investment advice, and that the schemes may or may not have investments in those sectors.
results.source_clause: Internal compliance checklist — Disclaimer Repository (Sector disclaimer)

results.title: Registered name and SEBI registration number
results.description: The creative must display the AMC's registered name and SEBI registration number. In video and audio (audio-visual) content they must appear at the beginning of the content (effective 1 May 2026); in static creatives (print, image, key visual) prominent display — for example a footer — satisfies the requirement.
results.source_clause: SEBI requirement effective 2026-05-01 (registered name + registration number at the start of audio-visual securities-market content; prominent display on static creatives); internal checklist — Disclaimer Repository (SEBI registration number, mandatory)
results.offending_text: Axis Large Cap Fund — Direct Plan (Growth) delivered an impressive 15% return over the last 1 year.
results.explanation: The ad never states the AMC's full registered company name or its SEBI registration number, which investors need to verify the fund house's identity and regulatory status.
results.suggested_rewrite: Add a footer line with the AMC's full registered name (e.g., 'Axis Asset Management Company Limited') and its SEBI registration number (e.g., 'SEBI Regn. No. INXXXXXXXXX').

results.title: Taxation disclaimer when tax implications are mentioned
results.description: When tax benefits or tax implications are mentioned, the creative must carry the taxation disclaimer advising investors to consult their tax advisors.
results.source_clause: Internal compliance checklist — Disclaimer Repository (Taxation disclaimer)

results.title: Fund-of-Funds recurring-expenses disclaimer
results.description: For Fund of Funds schemes, the creative must disclose that investors bear the recurring expenses of the scheme in addition to the expenses of the underlying schemes.
results.source_clause: Internal compliance checklist — Disclaimer Repository (FOF Schemes disclaimer)

results.title: ELSS lock-in and tax-benefit disclaimer
results.description: For ELSS / tax-saver schemes, the creative must disclose the 3-year lock-in and the Section 80C eligibility, and advise investors to consult their own tax consultant.
results.source_clause: Internal compliance checklist — Disclaimer Repository (ELSS disclaimer)

results.title: Graph illustration disclaimer
results.description: When a graph is shown, the creative must carry the graph disclaimer clarifying it is for illustration only, not for developing or implementing an investment strategy, and that past performance may or may not be sustained.
results.source_clause: Internal compliance checklist — Disclaimer Repository (Graph disclaimer)

results.title: Market-cap definitions when cap terms are used
results.description: When large-cap / mid-cap / small-cap terms are used, the creative must include the SEBI market-capitalisation definitions.
results.source_clause: Internal compliance checklist — Disclaimer Repository (Market Cap definitions)

results.title: Index-provider licensing disclaimer
results.description: For index funds / ETFs based on an NSE or BSE index, the creative must carry the applicable index-provider (NSE Indices / AIPL-BSE) licensing disclaimer stating the scheme is not sponsored, endorsed, or promoted by the index provider.
results.source_clause: Internal compliance checklist — Disclaimer Repository (Index/ETF index-licensing disclaimers)

results.title: Exchange-listing disclaimer
results.description: For ETFs and close-ended schemes listed on NSE / BSE, the creative must carry the exchange's disclaimer that the permission given by the exchange does not imply approval of the SID or scheme.
results.source_clause: Internal compliance checklist — Disclaimer Repository (NSE/BSE listing disclaimers)

results.title: Offshore-promotion disclaimer
results.description: When domestic schemes are promoted to offshore investors, the creative must carry the offshore disclaimer clarifying it is not a solicitation or offer to offshore investors and that the product is meant for investors based in India.
results.source_clause: Internal compliance checklist — Disclaimer Repository (offshore-investor advertisement disclaimer)

results.title: App-rating disclaimer
results.description: When an app-store rating is displayed, the creative must clarify that the rating is not for the schemes of the AMC.
results.source_clause: Internal compliance checklist — Disclaimer Repository (App Rating disclaimer)

results.title: Risk-profiler / goal-planner tool disclaimer
results.description: When a risk profiler, goal planner, or similar planning tool is presented, the creative must carry the tool disclaimer that it is only an aid based on the investor's inputs and that investors are responsible for their own decisions.
results.source_clause: Internal compliance checklist — Disclaimer Repository (Risk Profiler / Goal Planner disclaimer)

results.title: Asset-allocation / investment-strategy disclaimer
results.description: When current portfolio allocation or investment strategy is shown, the creative must state that it is based on current market conditions and subject to change per the fund manager's view, and refer to the SID.
results.source_clause: Internal compliance checklist — Disclaimer Repository (Asset Allocation & Investment Strategy disclaimer)

results.title: SIP low-ticket availability disclaimer
results.description: When a SIP as low as ₹100 or ₹10 is advertised, the creative must clarify that not all schemes offer this feature.
results.source_clause: Internal compliance checklist — Disclaimer Repository (SIP as low as 100/10)

results.title: Small-cap SIP/STP registration restriction disclaimer
results.description: For small-cap schemes, where a per-instalment SIP/STP restriction applies, the creative must disclose the applicable registration limit.
results.source_clause: Internal compliance checklist — Disclaimer Repository (Small Cap disclaimer)

results.title: CAGR for 1Y / 3Y / 5Y / since inception
results.description: Performance must be advertised in terms of CAGR for at least the past 1 year, 3 years, 5 years, and since inception.
results.source_clause: MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, para 14.2.1(a)
results.offending_text: delivered an impressive 15% return over the last 1 year.
results.explanation: The ad only shows the 1-year return but leaves out the required 3-year, 5-year, and since-inception performance figures, which could mislead investors about the fund's long-term track record.
results.suggested_rewrite: Add the fund's CAGR figures for 3 years, 5 years, and since inception alongside the existing 1-year return, e.g., '15% (1 year), X% (3 years), Y% (5 years), Z% (since inception)'.

results.title: Point-to-point return on ₹10,000
results.description: Point-to-point returns on a standard investment of Rs. 10,000 must also be provided alongside CAGR.
results.source_clause: MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, para 14.2.1(b)
results.offending_text: delivered an impressive 15% return over the last 1 year
results.explanation: The ad only states a percentage return but never shows what a standard Rs. 10,000 investment would have grown to, which investors need to understand the actual money impact.
results.suggested_rewrite: Add a line such as 'A Rs. 10,000 investment made 1 year ago would be worth approximately Rs. X today (CAGR: 15%)' next to the return figure.

results.title: Plan stated + different-expense-structure footnote
results.description: It must be specifically mentioned whether the performance shown is of the Direct or Regular plan, along with a footnote stating that different plans have a different expense structure.
results.source_clause: MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, para 14.2.1(d)

results.title: Data as of last day of preceding month-end
results.description: Performance information must be based on the period computed from the last day of the month-end preceding the date of the advertisement.
results.source_clause: MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, para 14.2.1(c)
results.offending_text: delivered an impressive 15% return over the last 1 year
results.explanation: The ad shows a return figure without stating the 'as on' date it was calculated from, so there's no way to confirm it uses the month-end date just before the ad's release as required.
results.suggested_rewrite: Add the specific reference date, e.g., 'delivered a 15% return over the last 1 year as on [last month-end date before ad release]', so the performance period is clearly tied to the correct month-end cutoff.

results.title: Fund-manager-change footnote
results.description: If the scheme has not been managed by the same fund manager for the full period of the performance shown, that must be disclosed in a footnote.
results.source_clause: MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, paras 14.2.1(e), 14.2.6(c)
results.explanation: Assisted rule — requires a human check.

results.title: Short-track-record performance limits
results.description: Where the scheme has been in existence for less than six months, past performance must not be provided; if in existence for more than six months but less than one year, only the simple annualised growth rate (past 6 months and since inception) may be shown.
results.source_clause: MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, para 14.2.2
results.explanation: Assisted rule — requires a human check.

results.title: Scheme and benchmark risk-o-meter when performance shown
results.description: When the performance of a scheme or benchmark is displayed, the risk-o-meter of both the scheme and the benchmark must be given.
results.source_clause: Internal Performance checklist item 12; MF Master Circular 2026-03-20 (product labelling)
results.explanation: Assisted rule — requires a human check.

results.title: SIP performance requires lumpsum, cash-flow detail, and XIRR note
results.description: When SIP performance is shown, the corresponding scheme lumpsum performance must also be shown, the SIP instalment periodicity must be stated, and an XIRR note must be given for the SIP returns.
results.source_clause: Internal Performance checklist items 16-17; MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, Chapter 14

results.title: Other schemes managed by the same fund manager
results.description: When a scheme's performance is advertised, performance of the other schemes managed by the same fund manager must be included (1Y/3Y/5Y CAGR with benchmarks); if the fund manager manages more than six schemes, disclose the total number and the top-3 and bottom-3 schemes.
results.source_clause: MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, para 14.2.6
results.explanation: Assisted rule — requires a human check.

results.title: IDCW payout disclosures
results.description: While advertising IDCW payouts, the IDCW declared or paid must be shown in rupees per unit along with the face value and the prevailing NAV at declaration; and immediately below any pay-out figure it must be stated that the NAV falls to the extent of the payout and statutory levy.
results.source_clause: MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, paras 14.1.1-14.1.3

results.title: Short-horizon fund annualised yields
results.description: For Overnight, Liquid, and Money Market funds, performance may be advertised by simple annualisation of yields only if a figure is available for at least 7, 15, and 30 calendar days, and provided it does not present an unrealistic or misleading picture.
results.source_clause: MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, para 14.2.3
results.explanation: Assisted rule — requires a human check.

results.title: Additional benchmark disclosure
results.description: Performance must also show the prescribed additional benchmark for the scheme category (e.g. Sensex/Nifty for equity, 1-year T-Bill for short-duration debt/arbitrage, 10-year GOI security for other debt), in INR and as CAGR, alongside the scheme benchmark.
results.source_clause: MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, para 14.2.4
results.explanation: Assisted rule — requires a human check.

results.title: Period-specific performance labelling
results.description: Any disclosure of quarterly, half-yearly, or yearly performance must pertain to the respective calendar quarter, half-year, or year only.
results.source_clause: MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, para 14.2.5
results.offending_text: delivered an impressive 15% return over the last 1 year
results.explanation: The return is shown for a rolling 'last 1 year' period instead of an actual calendar year, which the rule requires so investors aren't misled by cherry-picked time windows.
results.suggested_rewrite: Change the performance disclosure to reflect the return for the actual calendar year (e.g., 'returned 15% in calendar year 2025') instead of a trailing 12-month figure.

results.title: Post-merger performance disclosure
results.description: Where performance is shown for a scheme that resulted from a merger, the correct surviving-scheme rule must be applied: weighted-average performance when both schemes had identical features, the retained scheme's performance when its features are retained, and no past performance when a new scheme emerges.
results.source_clause: MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, para 14.3

results.title: AUM figure requires link to AUM breakdown
results.description: Where AUM figures are included, a link to the report on AUM by geography and asset class on the website must be given.
results.source_clause: Internal Performance checklist item 18; MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, Chapter 14
results.offending_text: with a link to AUM by geography at [AMC website]/aum
results.explanation: The rule requires the AUM link to point to a report showing AUM broken down by both geography and asset class, but the ad only mentions geography, leaving out the asset-class breakdown investors need.
results.suggested_rewrite: Change the text to 'with a link to the report on AUM by geography and asset class at [AMC website]/aum' and ensure the linked page actually shows both breakdowns.

results.title: Yield creative required fields
results.description: A creative showing yield must display the scheme name and description, the annualised Portfolio YTM (semi-annualised YTM to be annualised), the Macaulay Duration, the Residual Maturity, and the 'as on' date, in addition to the applicable product label, risk-o-meter, and standard disclaimers.
results.source_clause: Internal checklist (Yield creative requirements); MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, Chapter 14

results.title: No indicative portfolio or yield
results.description: Mutual Funds, AMCs, and distributors must not offer any indicative portfolio or indicative yield, and no communication in this regard shall be issued (for open-ended schemes).
results.source_clause: MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, para 14.4.1
results.explanation: The creative only states the fund's actual historical 1-year return and AUM figures, not any projected or indicative yield or portfolio, so it does not violate this rule.

results.title: 13% cap on depicted future returns in tools
results.description: In tools such as goal-planning calculators and return illustrations in non-scheme-related material, the higher range of the intended return depicted must not exceed 13%.
results.source_clause: AMFI Best Practices Guidelines Circular No. 109/2023-24 (usage of illustrations for future returns)

results.title: No cross-selling of other products
results.description: A mutual fund advertisement must not cross-sell or promote any other product or business — for example AIF or PMS offerings, insurance, or other group products. No other business may be promoted in an MF advertisement.
results.source_clause: Internal Dos & Don'ts (no cross-selling of other products in an MF advertisement)
results.explanation: The creative only talks about the Axis Large Cap Fund itself and doesn't mention or promote any other product, service, or business like insurance, PMS, or AIF.

results.title: Statistics and charts must cite a reliable source
results.description: Statistical information, charts, and graphs, when used, must be supported by their source. A reliable, preferably publicly available source must be quoted wherever data, graphs, or charts are shown, and the figures must be verifiable and correct.
results.source_clause: Internal Dos & Don'ts (statistics/charts must be source-supported); Sixth Schedule (Advertisement Code) clause (a)

results.title: Content and disclaimers must be legible
results.description: All content of the advertisement — and especially the disclaimers and notes — must be legible and in a readable font size commensurate with the size of the other text in the creative.
results.source_clause: Sixth Schedule (Advertisement Code) clause (i) (legible fonts); internal Dos & Don'ts (legibility / commensurate font size)

results.claim_text: Axis Large Cap Fund — Direct Plan (Growth) delivered an impressive 15% return over the last 1 year
The fund manages ₹30,912 crore in assets under management

notes.note: Highlighting only the 1-year return as 'impressive' without showing the benchmark's 1-year return or the fund's 3/5-year figures lets a reader assume this single data point represents consistent skill, when a large-cap fund's one-year number can be driven by market timing rather than manager performance.
